resume.name: Inez Ng
resume.summary: Technology associate with transferable experience in risk assessment, ISO 27001 and security policies. Used risk assessment and ISO 27001 to perform technology risk assessments. Applied security policies to maintain security policies and controls and documented decisions for technical and business reviewers. Collaborated with four colleagues to support internal and external audits and presented progress during fortnightly reviews. Managed approximately 27 work items per month while tracking quality checks and follow-up actions. Supported recurring operational work using audit support and documented step-by-step procedures. Investigated service requests, recorded findings and escalated issues with clear supporting evidence. Created a simple reporting template that reduced manual preparation time by 9%. Built a fictional demonstration project using risk assessment, ISO 27001 and security policies. Tested the project with representative scenarios and recorded limitations and next steps. Presented the design and outcomes to a five-person peer review group.
